tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md and TODO markers; agent worked file-by-file with no manual inventory.
Caught 6 rows still Status=copied ('[FAIL] MIGRATION-MAPPING.md — 6 row(s) still Status=copied'); after fix reported PASS and a clean smoke launch (pid 23824).

special_apis.special_handling: Migrated as-is (supported on WinUI 3 desktop). Device-init wrapped in try/catch with a fallback panel per the skill's Defensive-UI rule; on a no-camera machine the empty-list branch is the live path.

errors_encountered.error: Validate-UwpMigration: 1 FAIL — 6 MIGRATION-MAPPING.md rows still Status=copied
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent finished transforming files but did not flip mapping Status from 'copied' to 'done'.
errors_encountered.fix: Flipped the 6 rows to 'done' and re-ran the validator → PASS. (Covered clearly by SKILL.md Step 4; a slip, not a skill gap.)

errors_encountered.error: git: 'LF would be replaced by CRLF in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Line-ending normalization on a skill doc the agent did not need to commit.
errors_encountered.fix: Non-fatal; did not affect the migration.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Camera-unavailable fallback message renders twice — once as a static orange XAML TextBlock and once as the dynamic FallbackMessage TextBlock showing the identical string.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Agent followed the skill's Defensive-UI wording ('a TextBlock saying "..." plus the exception's Message underneath') by creating a fixed headline TextBlock AND a detail TextBlock, then in the no-device empty-list branch (no exception available) passed the same fixed headline string into the detail line, so both show the same text.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: not resolved — shipped as a low-severity cosmetic discrepancy (discrepancies.json s1-duplicate-fallback-message).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Sharpening the SKILL.md 'Defensive UI for device-dependent features' section so the fallback renders the headline exactly once and the second/detail line is exception-only (empty when there is no exception, e.g. the empty-device-list case).

env_issues.issue: No camera on the validation machine; both UWP and WinUI report 'No source groups found.' and the UWP UI thread hung, so scenario 2's select→Start→preview flow is unverifiable for either app.
env_issues.workaround: Behavioural parity scored conservatively as partial; not a migration defect.
